styleLock.direction: soft coral beauty patch ecommerce, tidy retail infographic
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat field per shot, never mixed: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, blush-coral panel #F2B8AC for benefit, use and set screens, warm greige board #E7E0DB for skin macros and infographic screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light at 5600K, front-left key with white bounce fill, contact shadows only, a thin skim of side light reserved for texture macros, no hard speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte studio paper and warm greige board #E7E0DB, low matte ledge for lineup screens, no wood or marble grain, no reflective acrylic
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one heavy headline weight plus one light body weight, deep charcoal type, every in-image line stays a blank placeholder slot
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, filled dot markers in accent #E24B3B, check and cross positions kept empty, one rounded card radius throughout
styleLock.presentationRules: retail box keeps the same straight-on or slight 3/4 hero angle and locked scale; loose patches always read as clean round discs with a tapered curling rim; skin is only ever an identity-free partial crop
noDrift: no recognizable faces or invented brand wordmarks
no invented numbers, rankings or certifications
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft coral beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, blush-coral panel #F2B8AC, warm greige board #E7E0DB and one vermillion accent #E24B3B with deep charcoal type; bright soft high-key studio lighting at 5600K with a front-left key, white bounce fill and contact shadows only, a thin skim of side light for texture macros; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline weight and one light body weight; thin-line icons and empty dot markers in the accent; matte paper and greige board surfaces only; stable locked product angle and scale; identity-free skin crops throughout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented claims or numbers.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，纯白底合规主图立住包装轮廓
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, retail box standing square to camera, full packaging visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with white fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: even clean margin all around, no copy space reserved
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The retail box standing upright on its base, photographed straight-on at eye level so the whole front panel reads square to camera and nothing is cropped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a front key with a white fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow only where the box meets the table. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, evenly balanced margin above and below, no extra whitespace and no reserved copy area. 4K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no added headline text, no callout graphics, no ranking badge or review stars, no quantity numerals overlaid, no watermark or QR code, no hands, no props, no grey or gradient cast on the backdrop, no crushed carton corners, no floating box without contact shadow.

shots.displayName: 贴片离型纸斜倚卖点图
shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：盒装旁铺开独立贴片，一眼看清内含物形态
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, box tilted back, strip of loose patches fanned to one side
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with a thin rim skimmed along the patch edges, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one fanned strip of individual round patches on its backing sheet
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the upper left third for copy
shots.textZone: upper left third, one headline slot
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The box shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle, tipped back against a clean tinted panel with its top flap lifted, and a fanned strip of loose round patches on its backing sheet resting on the surface beside it so the contents read at a glance. Soft front-left key light with a thin rim skimmed along the patch edges, soft contact shadows under both box and strip. Background flat blush-coral panel #F2B8AC. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space kept clear on the upper left third for one headline slot reading 「{selling_point_1}」. Negative: no invented brand wordmark, no piece count or duration figures rendered, no second claim, no extra text besides 「{selling_point_1}」, no patches floating without contact shadow, no props hiding the box face, no watermark.

shots.displayName: 脸颊局部痘点标记特写
shots.intent: 痛点放大：局部肌上一颗凸起痘点被圈出，贴片已在位
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, camera square and perpendicular to the skin surface
shots.lighting: soft diffused front light at 5600K plus a very low skim of side light revealing pore texture
shots.background: warm greige board #E7E0DB visible only as a narrow band at the right edge
shots.props: one fingertip entering from the lower edge
shots.whitespace: clear negative space along the lower right for copy
shots.textZone: lower right band, one short claim slot
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point macro of {product} already applied, framing an identity-free stretch of cheek skin only, cropped far away from eyes, nose and mouth so no face is recognizable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro with the camera square and perpendicular to the skin surface, shallow depth of field, one applied round patch sitting over a single raised blemish at a rule-of-thirds intersection, a thin dotted ring marker in accent #E24B3B circling it and one fingertip entering from the lower edge about to touch the rim. Soft diffused front light at 5600K with a very low skim of side light revealing real pore texture, skin keeping natural tone variation and visible fine detail. Warm greige board #E7E0DB visible only as a narrow band at the right edge. The skin and patch occupy 55-60% of the frame, clear negative space held along the lower right for one claim slot reading 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no recognizable face, no eyes or lips in frame, no retouched plastic skin, no inflamed wound gore, no enlarged spot beyond real scale, no fabricated results, no invented logo, no extra text besides 「{callout_1}」, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用单片薄膜与锥形边缘的微距证明结构工艺，替代参数文案
shots.camera: macro from a very low side angle skimmed almost along the surface
shots.lighting: single soft key from upper left with a bounce card underneath so light passes through the film
shots.whitespace: minimal, the material is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of one loose round patch peeled from {product}, tight zoom on its tapered rim. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera placed at a very low side angle skimmed almost along the surface so one corner of the film curls toward the lens and the thin taper reads as a translucent cross-section. Single soft key from the upper left with a white bounce card underneath so light passes through the film, one crisp small specular on the curl, faint contact shadow beneath the lifted edge. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The macro detail occupies 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace since the material itself is the subject, no reserved copy area. 4K macro clarity. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated or extra patches, no fingers pinching the product, no coloured cast inside the translucent film, no medical instrument or needle imagery, no text overlay, no watermark.

shots.intent: 使用瞬间的场景代入，让买家把自己放进这个动作里
shots.camera: eye-level side profile crop of jaw, chin edge and neck only
shots.lighting: soft wraparound front-right studio light at 5600K with gentle falloff
shots.props: one raised hand with thumb and forefinger at the patch edge
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left half for copy
shots.textZone: left half, one short line slot
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle use moment: {product} being lifted away from the skin at the end of its wear time. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Framed as an identity-free side profile crop of jaw line, chin edge and neck only, never rising above the mouth, so no eyes and no facial identity appear, with one hand raised and thumb and forefinger peeling the patch edge up. Eye-level side profile camera. Soft wraparound studio light at 5600K from the front right with gentle falloff, skin keeping real texture and fine lines. Background flat blush-coral studio paper #F2B8AC. The product and the peel point occupy 40-50% of the frame, generous clean negative space kept across the left half for one line slot reading 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no recognizable face or identity, no eyes in frame, deformed or extra fingers banned, no plastic smoothed skin, no exaggerated residue shown on the removed patch, no invented logo, no extra text besides 「{selling_point_2}」, no watermark.

shots.intent: 三步机制图消除用法疑虑，编号与标签留空
shots.camera: flat lay from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle onto laid-out panel cards
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft short shadows, identical light inside all three panels
shots.background: warm greige board #E7E0DB with three white cards #FFFFFF on it
shots.props: three blank numbered dot markers in accent #E24B3B
shots.whitespace: clear empty bands under each panel for copy
shots.textZone: three label bands beneath the panels, blank slots
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic step screen for {product}: three matched vertical photo panels in one row on white cards laid over a warm greige board #E7E0DB, with three blank numbered dot markers in accent #E24B3B and empty label bands underneath. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat lay camera looking directly down from above at a 90-degree overhead angle onto the laid-out cards, while each card itself holds an identity-free close crop of hand and cheek or jaw only, first card a fingertip separating a patch from its backing sheet, second card the patch pressed onto skin, third card the edge lifted free. Even high-key flat lighting with soft short shadows, identical camera and light inside all three panels. The three panels together occupy 35-40% of the frame, clear empty bands kept under each panel for three short label slots reading 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」. Negative: no invented step wording, no dense body text, no recognizable face in any panel, no mismatched lighting between panels, no duplicated hands, no hours or day-night figures, no watermark, no extra text besides the three label slots.

shots.intent: 保留分栏与勾叉位结构帮助选款，两侧主张全部留空
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down along a row of three upright boxes onto the flat table below
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, thin clean shadows, no drama
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with pale warm grey row cards
shots.props: three boxes, blank tick and cross dot circles
shots.whitespace: generous side margins kept clear for row labels
shots.textZone: five row labels at left plus one headline above the columns, blank slots
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen for {product}: a row of three upright option boxes across the top above five rounded horizontal table rows, each row carrying a blank label at the left and three empty marker circles aligned under the columns so each column keeps one colour code. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the row of boxes, the matrix table rendered flat and square in the lower two thirds. Even soft studio light with thin clean shadows. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with the row cards in a pale warm grey and the marker circles outlined in accent #E24B3B. The boxes and table together occupy 50-60% of the frame, generous side margins kept clear for row label slots reading 「{callout_5}」 and one headline slot above the columns reading 「{selling_point_3}」. Negative: no competitor brand names or real logos, no ranking badge or award seal, no pre-filled ticks implying tested data, no tiny unreadable text, no misaligned columns between the two halves, no watermark, no extra text besides the blank slots.

shots.intent: 同系列搭配与规格可选，中央主产品带两侧空位

shots.lighting: soft front key with a subtle rim separating the units, long soft shadows onto the ledge
shots.props: two companion units, one blank circular seal outline
shots.whitespace: clear space below the shelf line for copy
shots.textZone: three name lines below the shelf plus one blank seal circle at upper right

Three units arranged on a low matte ledge, the reference product centred and dominant with one companion unit either side set slightly further back, all photographed from a low angle looking gently upward so the trio reads as a matched set on a shared shelf plane, full products visible. Soft front key light with a subtle rim separating the units from the backdrop, long soft shadows falling back onto the ledge. Background flat blush-coral #F2B8AC. The trio occupies 60-70% of the frame overall, clear space kept below the shelf line for three blank name slots reading 「{callout_6}」, 「{callout_7}」, 「{callout_8}」 and one empty circular seal outline in accent #E24B3B at the upper right. Negative: no ranking or first-place claim inside the seal, no real brand names, mismatched scale between the three units banned, no duplicated product faces, no invented product typography, no extra text besides the three name slots, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以品牌主张式版面收口降风险，署名与主张均留空
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level portrait camera, person cropped just below the eyes
shots.lighting: soft broad front light at 5600K with gentle shadow wrap, no beauty retouch
shots.props: product held at the lower edge of frame, one blank attribution rule line
shots.whitespace: large clean text block reserved on the left half
shots.textZone: left half statement slot plus two blank attribution lines beneath it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and brand-values screen: {product} resting casually at the lower edge of frame beside a seated person against a warm greige studio backdrop #E7E0DB. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level portrait camera with the person cropped just below the eyes so no facial identity is recognizable, chin resting on a relaxed hand, natural skin texture and real tone kept. Soft broad front light at 5600K with gentle shadow wrap, no beauty retouch. The person and product together occupy 50-60% of the frame, a large clean text block reserved across the left half for one statement slot reading 「{selling_point_4}」 with two blank attribution rule lines beneath it. Negative: no recognizable face or identity, no real person name or job title rendered, no award seal or ranking badge, no review stars, deformed hand or extra fingers banned, no watermark, no extra text besides 「{selling_point_4}」.

provenance.notes: 源 9 张主图逐图事实：009 盒装正面白底主图；001 盒装 3/4 立体图配一列圆形贴片离型纸；002 脸颊局部肌上已贴一片并用虚线圈标记、指腹入画；003 下颌与手部揭下贴片的侧面特写；006 单片半透明贴片微距、边缘卷起显锥度、左上标题位与三条勾选位；004 三格步骤图下方编号圆点与短标签；007 三盒并列加五行勾选矩阵的选款表；005 三件同系列搭配陈列、下方三列名称短句、右上圆形徽章位；008 人物半身加整段主张文字与署名行。品类判定依据：图为贴敷于面部局部肌肤的祛痘贴片及其零售盒装，属护理清洁类贴片而非着色彩妆，故 L1 判「护肤个护」、L2 判「面部护理」，与提示一致。已剥离内容：原字标与系列名、片数数字、吸出与时长类功效原句、榜首类排行徽章、勾选卖点原句、步骤原句、人物姓名头衔与可辨识面容、评论星条；图内文案位一律改为带编号的卖点与批注空位，对比与选款只保留分栏、编号与勾叉位结构，全部特写为无身份局部皮肤。
